step_mass_scope: Uniform-density comparison of the tube-only export; STEP itself supplies no material assignment. Solid order is not a component mapping.

sampled_clearance.scope: Native reference primitives versus actual native tubes at 25 poses. Primitive overlap volumes must not be summed as a unique compound volume.

evidence_boundary: Fresh reopened-artifact observations only. No geometry or physical acceptance is inferred from process completion. A separate retained verifier must evaluate actual inputs and these observations.
